title: EntityPropertyDescriptor
description: Describes one dynamic entity property. Properties define persisted data fields, enum fields, foreign keys, upload fields, primitive collections, calculated formulas, rollups, server-only fields, defaults, uniqueness, and validators.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: use PascalCase property names. Use `type` for primitive fields, `type: "enum"` with `enumType` for enum fields, and a `foreignKey` object for lookup fields. FK property names should normally end with `Id`. Add `collection` for ordered value lists, `formula` for virtual calculated values, and `rollup` for aggregates over related records; these three and `foreignKey` are mutually exclusive. Keep sensitive values `serverOnly: true`. Do not add legacy UI configuration here; page columns/filters and form fields own UI behavior.

name.description: Stable PascalCase property name, unique within the entity. Examples: 'Name', 'EmailAddress', 'CustomerId', 'StartDate'.

type.description: Primitive or special property type. If omitted, runtime treats the property as string (or enum when enumType is set). Use 'enum' only with enumType; use 'file'/'image' for first-class upload fields.

displayName.description: Default display label for this property. Page columns and form fields can override it. Omit when the label can be derived from the property name.

enumType.description: Name of a JSON-defined enum from the enums collection or a full type name for code enums. Required when type is 'enum'; setting it without type implies 'enum'.

allowSetByClients.description: Controls whether create/update clients may set the property. Use false for server-computed or protected fields that can still be returned to clients. Forced to false for formula and rollup properties.

serverOnly.description: When true, this property is completely hidden from clients, API responses, and UI definitions. Use for secrets, internal notes, hashes, or backend-only workflow state.

isMappedToDbField.description: Whether this property uses a dedicated physical column. Omitted/false scalar properties use the configured dynamic data storage (JSON by default). Forced to false for formula and rollup properties; not applicable to collections.

defaultValue.description: Default value for new records. Stored as a string in descriptor JSON and converted to the declared property type at runtime. Examples: '0' for int/enum, 'true' for boolean, '2026-05-18T09:00:00Z' for datetime. Ignored for formula and rollup properties.

isUnique.description: Whether this property value must be unique across records of this entity. Use for codes, slugs, natural keys, and names only when duplicates are not allowed.

isRequired.description: When true, the property is required/not nullable. This affects database schema, backend validation, and generated UI validation. Existing data may need defaults before turning this on.

foreignKey.description: Foreign key/lookup relation. The current property's value stores the referenced entity id. The property name should usually be '<ReferencedEntity>NameId', for example 'CustomerId'.

fileMaxSizeBytes.description: Maximum allowed file size in bytes for File and Image properties. Example: 5242880 for 5 MiB.

fileAllowedContentTypes.description: Allowed MIME content types or wildcard patterns for File and Image properties. Examples: 'image/*', 'application/pdf'.

imageMaxWidth.description: Optional maximum image width in pixels.

imageMaxHeight.description: Optional maximum image height in pixels.

imageResizeMode.description: How uploaded images should be resized when image dimensions are configured. 'fit' preserves the full image inside the bounds; 'fill' crops/fills the target bounds (requires both imageMaxWidth and imageMaxHeight).

decimalPlaces.description: Decimal scale for 'decimal' and 'money' properties. Controls storage precision and default UI formatting. Defaults to 2 when omitted.

currencySymbol.description: Optional currency symbol or code displayed by money-aware controls for 'money' properties, for example '$' or 'EUR'.

collection.description: Turns this property into an ordered list of values of the declared type. Cannot be combined with foreignKey, formula, or rollup.

formula.description: Virtual calculated value evaluated from other properties of the same record. Makes the property read-only and non-persisted.

rollup.description: Virtual aggregate over related records that reference this record. Makes the property read-only and non-persisted.

validators.description: Backend/UI validators for this property. Use required, length, range, pattern, email, phone, url, or creditCard as appropriate. Duplicate required can be omitted when isRequired is true unless a custom message is needed.
